description:
Who is Element?
We serve as a partner at the intersection of innovation and our clients' needs, efficiently crafting meaningful user experiences for government and commercial customers. By breaking complex problems down into their fundamental elements, we create modern digital solutions that drive efficiency, maximize taxpayer dollars, and deliver essential outcomes that serve the people. 
Why Work at Element?
Make an impact that resonates-join our vibrant team and discover how you can improve lives through digital transformation.  Our talented professionals bring unparalleled energy and engagement, setting a higher standard for impactful work. Be a part of our team and shape a better future. 
Position Summary
Element Solutions is looking for a growth oriented and enthusiastic BI Tableau Developer.  This individual is responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and enhancing interactive dashboards, business intelligence solutions, and reporting interfaces that transform data from multiple sources into actionable insights. This role leverages Tableau and other reporting tools to support management reporting, operational analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
The BI Tableau Developer collaborates with data engineers, software developers, business stakeholders, and project leadership to gather reporting requirements, assess visualization tools, and deliver user-friendly reporting solutions. The position also supports the development of interfaces that present the results of Natural Language Processing (NLP) analysis, including capabilities for document categorization, tagging, and lookup.

Key Responsibilities 
 
 Business Intelligence, Visualization, and Reporting 


 
 Develop, test, and maintain Tableau dashboards and reports that communicate key performance indicators, metrics, trends, and operational or management insights.



 
 Use approved data sources to create reporting views; collaborate with data engineers and analysts when new integrations or data transformations are needed.



 
 Configure or support data refresh schedules in line with business requirements.



 
 Validate calculations, filters, data accuracy, and dashboard functionality before release.



 
 Improve dashboard performance, usability, and accessibility based on user feedback and established standards.



 
 Document dashboard data sources, business rules, calculations, and refresh schedules.



 
 Evaluate reporting or visualization tools when the team needs to compare solutions or meet a specific customer requirement.




 User Interface and Reporting Solutions 


 
 Support the development and maintenance of reporting interfaces in customer-approved environments, including integrating Tableau dashboards into existing applications or platforms.



 
 Help present NLP-generated document classifications and tags so authorized users can review, search, filter, and look up analyzed documents.



 
 Work with data engineers and developers to clarify data dependencies and resolve issues affecting reporting interfaces or NLP results.



 
 Gather user feedback and recommend improvements to interface navigation, filtering, and usability.



 
 Support user acceptance testing to confirm that interface changes meet functional and business requirements.




 Data Quality and Technical Support 


 
 Work with data engineers and analysts to understand data sources, structures, and transformations, and to investigate discrepancies between source data and dashboard results.



 
 Help troubleshoot dashboard and data-refresh issues, escalating problems that require changes to source systems or pipelines.



 
 Support testing and release of dashboard or reporting-interface updates.



 
 Follow established security, privacy, access-control, and data-handling requirements when working with customer and organizational data.






Minimum Requirements 
 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Associates degree plus two years' experience.



 
 At least 2 years of professional experience in business intelligence, Tableau development, data visualization, or reporting.



 
 Hands-on experience developing and maintaining dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Tableau.



 
 Proficiency in SQL for querying, validating, and analyzing data from relational databases or other data sources.



 
 Understanding of data visualization principles, dashboard design, data modeling, and KPI reporting.



 
 Experience connecting reporting tools to multiple data sources and validating report accuracy.



 
 Familiarity with dashboard filters, parameters, calculated fields, data extracts, and scheduled data refreshes in Tableau.



 
 Understanding of Agile development practices and Scrum principles.



 
 Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.



 
 Ability to manage multiple tasks, collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, and meet established project deadlines.



 
 Must live in the Continental US.



 
 Be either a US citizen or Permanent Resident due to the work we do. 



 
 Depending on agency requirements, you may need to possess or obtain a Public Trust designation or security clearance. Regardless of the specific requirement, all positions require the successful completion of a background check, background investigation, and the standard onboarding process.






Preferred Qualifications 
 

 
 Experience in government contracting, healthcare CMS (Center of Medicare & Medicaid) or in the health industry.



 
 Experience developing dashboards for management reporting, operational performance monitoring, or executive decision-making.



 
 Familiarity with Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud administration, publishing, permissions, and scheduled refresh management.



 
 Experience integrating reporting interfaces into existing business applications or workflows.



 
 Exposure to NLP, document analytics, automated categorization, tagging, search, or document management systems.



 
 Familiarity with Python, JavaScript, or other scripting languages used to support data processing or interface functionality.



 
 Experience with Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms.



 
 Qualified individuals living in HUBZone-certified areas are strongly encouraged to apply. To find out if you live in a HUBZone go to: https://maps.certify.sba.gov/hubzone/map#center=44.722800,-103.249700&zoom=4 . 






Our People
We invest in the lives of our employees, both in and out of the workplace, by providing competitive pay and benefits packages. Benefits offered may include health care, dental, vision, life insurance; 401(k); paid time off including PTO, holidays, and any other paid leave required by law. 
Location
Be in your Element. We are a remote first company based out of Washington, DC. As a HUBZone-certified business we are committed to supporting local economic development. 
 
Element is an equal opportunity employer  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected class. 
We believe in a world where solutions we build improve the lives of those who use them.
